clauses.quote: the unit member may appeal to the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources, or designee
clauses.notes: Conditional clause 'If agreement is not reached...' omitted for operational focus.

clauses.quote: who shall make the final decision.
clauses.notes: Relative clause 'who' refers to the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources, or designee.

clauses.quote: Probationary, pre-intern/intern, temporary, categorically funded, and emergency-credentialed unit members shall be formally evaluated in writing no more than twice annually.
clauses.subject_text: Probationary, pre-intern/intern, temporary, categorically funded, and emergency-credentialed unit members
clauses.notes: Passive construction imposes evaluation schedule duty on the district.

clauses.quote: Permanent unit members with a satisfactory evaluation the preceding year, including ROP teachers and categorically funded unit members who have been employed in the district at least three (3) consecutive preceding years, shall be evaluated every other school year except per Ed. Code 44938.
clauses.subject_text: Permanent unit members with a satisfactory evaluation the preceding year, including ROP teachers and categorically funded unit members who have been employed in the district at least three (3) consecutive preceding years
clauses.notes: Reduces evaluation frequency based on performance and tenure.

clauses.quote: Permanent unit members with at least ten (10) years of District service who are highly qualified (pursuant to ESEA/NCLB) and whose previous evaluation meets Standards may mutually agree in writing with her/his evaluator to be evaluated at least every five (5) years.
clauses.subject_text: Permanent unit members with at least ten (10) years of District service who are highly qualified (pursuant to ESEA/NCLB) and whose previous evaluation meets Standards
clauses.notes: Grants permission to negotiate reduced evaluation frequency.

clauses.quote: The unit member or the evaluator may rescind this agreement at any time but not during the school year the evaluation is taking place except per Ed. Code 44938.
clauses.subject_text: The unit member or the evaluator
clauses.notes: Mutual right to rescind reduced-evaluation agreement, with timing restriction.

clauses.quote: If a unit member transfers or changes assignments during the five (5) year period, a new agreement shall be signed, if mutual agreement continues.
clauses.notes: Requires renewal of reduced-evaluation agreement upon transfer/change.

clauses.quote: The unit member being evaluated and the evaluator shall select observation times, dates, conferences and final evaluation dates.
clauses.subject_text: The unit member being evaluated and the evaluator
clauses.notes: Joint obligation to schedule evaluation components.

clauses.quote: The unit member and designated evaluator shall agree in writing upon a revised schedule.
clauses.subject_text: The unit member and designated evaluator
clauses.notes: Joint obligation to formalize schedule changes in writing.

clauses.quote: The Unit Member may request a change of designated evaluator in writing including reasons for the request.
clauses.notes: Grants right to request evaluator change.

clauses.quote: If the designated evaluator denies the request, the unit member may appeal to the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources, or designee.
clauses.notes: Grants right to appeal denial of evaluator change.

clauses.quote: The reasons for denial of a change of evaluator shall be given in writing to the unit member upon their request.
clauses.subject_text: The reasons for denial of a change of evaluator
clauses.notes: Passive construction imposes duty on evaluator/district to provide written denial reasons.

clauses.quote: Reasons for denial shall not be arbitrary or capricious.
clauses.notes: Prohibits arbitrary or capricious denials of evaluator changes.
